query:
SELECT e.friend_id
            FROM realtime_friend_edges e
            WHERE e.user_id = $1
              AND e.removed
              AND NOT EXISTS (
                  SELECT 1 FROM realtime_dm_pairs p
                  WHERE p.user_a = LEAST($1, e.friend_id)
                    AND p.user_b = GREATEST($1, e.friend_id)
              )
